description: BuildingSync is a common XML schema for building energy audit data, so that audit results can be aggregated, compared and exchanged between the software and databases used in the audit process. It was developed because no industry-standard collection format for audit data existed, and it aims to cut duplicated effort in later audits and raise the value of audit data for auditors, software providers, owners and utilities. The website offers a validator that checks XML files against schema versions and use cases, a schema viewer and data dictionary, tools for authoring files, use cases and a case study; release 2.7.0 of the schema came out on 26 September 2025 without breaking changes. Coverage: building energy audits, mainly in US practice. Access: schema, validator and documentation on the website. Licence: not stated on the page read; free. Caveats: the schema describes audit content, so the quality of any dataset depends on the audits behind it. Simulation uses are passing audited building characteristics and measures into energy models and portfolio analyses. Related records: BEDES and the SEED Platform.
